purpose: bounded four-route reproducibility evidence using orchestrator-verified physically isolated role workspaces
claim_limit: bounded reproducibility only; no rights clearance, gold promotion, publication, release, maturity promotion or G2 passage

scope.semantic_task: Extract the sole observation in the prospectively bound response and preserve the exact publisher labels for total district, Family law, total conclusion stage, 2013 and Concluded cases, total.
Extract the 2025 registered-offence count for the complete source row labelled 11. ptk. Süüteod perekonna ja alaealiste vastu.
Extract the 2025 value for the source-defined Domestic violence row from the dashboard snapshot.
Extract the 2024/2025 actual-achievement percentage for maintenance matters finalised within 90 days from the date of proper service of process.

canonical_rules.locator: Use source-defined labels, not inferred coordinates: JSON dimensions joined in source order; spreadsheet sheet, complete row label and column label; CSV complete row label and year; PDF printed page, complete measure label and actual-achievement column.
canonical_rules.dates: Populate dates only when the source explicitly prints an ISO-equivalent start or end date for the observation; a year or financial-year label alone does not authorize inferred dates.
canonical_rules.unknown_semantics: Use source-defined or unknown semantics and unresolved uncertainty; never infer a denominator, cohort, population or time basis.
canonical_rules.component_values: Use an empty object unless the target itself explicitly requires multiple numeric components.

stopping_rules: any source digest or scope mismatch terminates the lineage
any prohibited personal or case-level data terminates the lineage
any role-isolation or artifact-binding failure terminates the lineage
any schema or seal failure terminates the lineage
any critical discrepancy terminates the lineage
no sealed-output repair, reuse, waiver, fuzzy match or automatic rerun
